name: flin-google-search-console-mcp
description: Analyse Google Search Console performance and inspect URLs with read-only access.
long_description: Connect your Google account to explore clicks, impressions, queries, pages and indexing status in Claude Desktop. A Google Cloud Desktop OAuth client with the Search Console API enabled is required. Google sign-in opens in your browser on the first data request. OAuth tokens are stored locally; requests go to Google and results return to Claude. This extension exposes no Search Console write operations. At every server start, automatically checks PyPI for the latest stable server version. Restart Claude to apply server updates; active sessions are not interrupted. Internet access is required at startup. Private extension configuration updates may still require a new bundle.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Client ID from your Google Cloud OAuth client of type Desktop app.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret belonging to the same Desktop app OAuth client.

default_site_url.title: Default Search Console property (optional)
default_site_url.description: For example sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/. You can also choose a property in each request.

tools.description: Summarise clicks, impressions, CTR and position.

tools.name: query_performance
tools.description: Query performance with dimensions and filters.

tools.name: get_dimension_breakdown

tools.description: Inspect Google's indexed status for a URL.
